# Parameters (tag this cell as "parameters" in Synapse)
ROOT          = "abfss://s62a@pinssts62adevukseftlkl.dfs.core.windows.net/PIPELINE"
INPUT_URI     = f"{ROOT}/INPUT/MASTER/MASTER LEGACY cases S62A - final.xlsx"
OUTPUT_URI    = f"{ROOT}/OUTPUT/VALIDATION/EXTRACTION"
LOCAL_PATH    = None      # set to a local .xlsx path to run outside Synapse
WRITE_OUTPUTS = True

DATA_SHEET      = "Final selected"
EXPECTED_SHEETS = ["Template", "Contradiction Summary", "Final selected"]
EXPECTED_COLS   = 196
HEADER_ROWS     = 3         # 0 = group, 1 = field name, 2 = source provenance
MIN_VALID_DATE  = "2015-01-01"

# Imports
import re
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd

RUN_TS  = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
TMP_XLS = "/tmp/s62a_master.xlsx"

# Load file
issues = []
def log(check, severity, case_ref=None, row=None, column=None, value=None, detail=None):
    issues.append({"check": check, "severity": severity, "case_ref": case_ref, "excel_row": row,
                   "column": column, "value": None if value is None else str(value)[:200], "detail": detail})

if LOCAL_PATH:
    src = LOCAL_PATH
else:
    import os
    from notebookutils import mssparkutils
    mssparkutils.fs.cp(INPUT_URI, f"file:{TMP_XLS}")
    print(f"File size: {os.path.getsize(TMP_XLS):,} bytes")
    src = TMP_XLS

xl = pd.ExcelFile(src, engine="openpyxl")
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)
for s in EXPECTED_SHEETS:
    if s not in xl.sheet_names:
        log("sheet_present", "ERROR", detail=f"Missing sheet '{s}'")

raw = pd.read_excel(xl, sheet_name=DATA_SHEET, header=None, dtype=object)
groups     = raw.iloc[0].ffill()
fields     = raw.iloc[1].astype(str).str.strip()
provenance = raw.iloc[2]
df = raw.iloc[HEADER_ROWS:].copy()
df.columns = fields
df["_excel_row"] = range(HEADER_ROWS + 1, HEADER_ROWS + 1 + len(df))
df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
print(f"Raw rows: {len(df)}, columns: {len(fields)}")

# 3. Column typing config
DATE_EXTRA = ["Application acknowledged", "Further info requested", "Application valid",
              "Valid letters sent", "LPA questionnaire sent", "Representations period - start",
              "Representations period - End", "Charging schedule sent", "Created on", "Last modified",
              "SAP 5 to FSSD", "Valid letters (17 & 9) to LPA and Applicant"]
DATE_COLS = [c for c in fields if re.search(r"date|deadline", c, re.I) or c in DATE_EXTRA]

NUMERIC_COLS = ["CIL amount", "Press notice cost", "Pre-application fee due", "Application fee amount",
                "Fee refund amount", "Area of site", "Site coordinates - Easting", "Site coordinates - Northing",
                "Hearing duration - prep (days)", "Hearing duration - sitting (days)",
                "Hearing duration - reporting (days)", "Estimated fee"]
NUMERIC_COLS += [c for c in fields if re.search(r"(Units|Change|SqM|Spaces|Difference|Count|CubicMetres|Throughput)$", c)]

YESNO_COLS = ["CIL liable", "EIA screening", "Site visibile from public land", "Pre-application fee required",
              "Application fee", "Fee refund", "IsWasteDevelopment", "Green belt", "BNG Exempt",
              "Health and safety issues", "Pre-application advice requested"]

ENUM_COLS = ["Pre-application status", "Application Status", "Stage", "Application phase",
             "Application classification", "Application type", "Application subtype", "LPA",
             "Applicant type", "Site area units", "Specialism", "Inspector band", "Category", "Procedure",
             "Site visit type", "Decision outcome", "Outcome type", "UseClass", "ParkingVehicleType",
             "ExistingHousingOccupancyType", "ExistingHousingUnitType",
             "ProposedHousingOccupancyType", "ProposedHousingUnitType"]

EMAIL_COLS    = [c for c in fields if "email" in c.lower()]
POSTCODE_COLS = [c for c in fields if re.search(r"post ?code", c, re.I)]

for lst in (DATE_COLS, NUMERIC_COLS, YESNO_COLS, ENUM_COLS):
    for c in [c for c in lst if c not in df.columns]:
        log("config_column_missing", "WARN", column=c, detail="Configured column not found in sheet")
DATE_COLS    = [c for c in dict.fromkeys(DATE_COLS) if c in df.columns]
NUMERIC_COLS = [c for c in dict.fromkeys(NUMERIC_COLS) if c in df.columns]
YESNO_COLS   = [c for c in YESNO_COLS if c in df.columns]
ENUM_COLS    = [c for c in ENUM_COLS if c in df.columns]

# 4. Column profile
def py_type(v):
    if isinstance(v, (datetime, pd.Timestamp)): return "datetime"
    if isinstance(v, bool): return "bool"
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)): return "number"
    return "str"

group_map = dict(zip(fields, groups))
prov_map  = {f: (prov_re.match(str(p)).group(2).lower() if prov_re.match(str(p)) else None)
             for f, p in zip(fields, provenance)}
profile = []
n = len(df)
for c in fields:
    s = df[c].dropna()
    s = s[s.astype(str).str.strip() != ""]
    types = s.map(py_type).value_counts().to_dict()
    profile.append({
        "column": c, "group": group_map.get(c), "source": prov_map.get(c),
        "expected_type": "date" if c in DATE_COLS else "numeric" if c in NUMERIC_COLS
                         else "yes_no" if c in YESNO_COLS else "enum" if c in ENUM_COLS else "text",
        "non_null": len(s), "null": n - len(s), "fill_pct": round(100 * len(s) / n, 1) if n else 0,
        "distinct": s.astype(str).nunique(), "observed_types": str(types),
        "mixed_types": len(types) > 1, "max_len": int(s.astype(str).str.len().max()) if len(s) else 0,
        "sample": " | ".join(s.astype(str).unique()[:3])[:200],
    })
    if len(s) == 0:
        log("column_all_null", "INFO", column=c, detail=f"group={group_map.get(c)}")
    elif len(types) > 1 and c not in DATE_COLS + NUMERIC_COLS:
        log("mixed_types", "WARN", column=c, detail=str(types))
profile_df = pd.DataFrame(profile)

# 7. Business rules
def yes(c, i): return str(df.at[i, c]).strip().lower() == "yes" if c in df.columns else False
def has(c, i): return c in df.columns and not pd.isna(df.at[i, c]) and str(df.at[i, c]).strip() != ""

DATE_ORDER = [
    ("Notification received date", "Expected submission date"),
    ("Pre-app/Application received date", "Application valid"),
    ("Application valid", "Decision date"),
    ("Pre-app/Application received date", "Decision date"),
    ("Application valid", "Target decision date"),
    ("Target decision date", "Extended target decision date"),
    ("Representations period - start", "Representations period - End"),
    ("LPA questionnaire sent", "LPA questionnaire rec'd date"),
]
for a, b in DATE_ORDER:
    if a not in parsed or b not in parsed: continue
    bad = parsed[a].notna() & parsed[b].notna() & (parsed[a] > parsed[b])
    for i in df[bad].index:
        log("date_sequence", "WARN", df.at[i, CR], df.at[i, "_excel_row"], f"{a} > {b}",
            f"{parsed[a][i].date()} > {parsed[b][i].date()}")

CONDITIONAL = [
    ("Decision outcome without Decision date", lambda i: has("Decision outcome", i) and not has("Decision date", i)),
    ("Decision date without Decision outcome", lambda i: has("Decision date", i) and not has("Decision outcome", i)),
    ("Application fee = Yes, no amount",       lambda i: yes("Application fee", i) and not has("Application fee amount", i)),
    ("Fee refund = Yes, no amount",            lambda i: yes("Fee refund", i) and not has("Fee refund amount", i)),
    ("Fee refund amount, Fee refund != Yes",   lambda i: has("Fee refund amount", i) and not yes("Fee refund", i)),
    ("CIL liable = Yes, no CIL amount",        lambda i: yes("CIL liable", i) and not has("CIL amount", i)),
    ("Organisation applicant, no org name",    lambda i: str(df.at[i, "Applicant type"]).strip() == "Organisation"
                                                         and not has("Applicant organisation name", i)),
    ("No LPA",                                 lambda i: not has("LPA", i)),
    ("No Application phase",                   lambda i: not has("Application phase", i)),
    ("Withdrawn date but status not withdrawn", lambda i: has("Withdrawn date", i)
                                                          and "withdraw" not in str(df.at[i, "Application Status"]).lower()),
]
for name, rule in CONDITIONAL:
    for i in df.index:
        try:
            if rule(i):
                log("business_rule", "WARN", df.at[i, CR], df.at[i, "_excel_row"], detail=name)
        except KeyError as e:
            log("business_rule_skipped", "INFO", detail=f"{name}: missing column {e}")
            break

# 9. Migration scope
in_scope = df[df["_ref_class"] != "INVALID"]
scope_df = pd.concat([
    in_scope.groupby("_ref_class").size().rename("cases").reset_index().rename(columns={"_ref_class": "key"}).assign(dimension="ref_class"),
    in_scope.groupby(in_scope["Application phase"].fillna("<NULL>")).size().rename("cases").reset_index()
            .rename(columns={"Application phase": "key"}).assign(dimension="application_phase"),
    in_scope.groupby("_ref_year").size().rename("cases").reset_index().rename(columns={"_ref_year": "key"}).assign(dimension="ref_year"),
    in_scope.groupby(in_scope["LPA"].fillna("<NULL>")).size().rename("cases").reset_index()
            .rename(columns={"LPA": "key"}).assign(dimension="lpa"),
    in_scope.groupby(in_scope["Application Status"].fillna("<NULL>")).size().rename("cases").reset_index()
            .rename(columns={"Application Status": "key"}).assign(dimension="application_status"),
])[["dimension", "key", "cases"]]

# 10. Summary
issues_df = pd.DataFrame(issues, columns=["check", "severity", "case_ref", "excel_row", "column", "value", "detail"])
cases_with_errors = issues_df.loc[(issues_df.severity == "ERROR") & issues_df.case_ref.notna(), "case_ref"].nunique()

summary = {
    "run_ts": RUN_TS, "source_file": INPUT_URI, "sheet": DATA_SHEET,
    "sheets_found": ", ".join(xl.sheet_names),
    "total_columns": len(fields),
    "columns_all_null": int((profile_df.non_null == 0).sum()),
    "columns_from_horizon": int((profile_df.source == "horizon").sum()),
    "columns_from_spreadsheet": int((profile_df.source == "spreadsheet").sum()),
    "case_note_columns": int((profile_df.group == "To be migrated from Spreadsheet to case notes").sum()),
    "total_rows": len(df), "blank_rows_dropped": int(blank_rows.sum()),
    "cases_in_scope": len(in_scope),
    "cases_excluded_invalid_ref": int((df._ref_class == "INVALID").sum()),
    "cases_redetermination": int((df._ref_class == "REDETERMINATION").sum()),
    "cases_with_errors": int(cases_with_errors),
    "issues_error": int((issues_df.severity == "ERROR").sum()),
    "issues_warn": int((issues_df.severity == "WARN").sum()),
    "issues_info": int((issues_df.severity == "INFO").sum()),
    "status": "FAIL" if (issues_df.severity == "ERROR").any() else "PASS",
}
summary_df = pd.DataFrame(list(summary.items()), columns=["metric", "value"])
check_counts = (issues_df.groupby(["severity", "check"]).size().rename("count")
                .reset_index().sort_values(["severity", "count"], ascending=[True, False]))

print(summary_df.to_string(index=False))
print("\n", check_counts.to_string(index=False))

# 11. Write outputs
if WRITE_OUTPUTS:
    report = f"/tmp/s62a_extraction_validation_{RUN_TS}.xlsx" if not LOCAL_PATH else f"s62a_extraction_validation_{RUN_TS}.xlsx"
    with pd.ExcelWriter(report, engine="openpyxl") as w:
        summary_df.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Summary", index=False)
        check_counts.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Check counts", index=False)
        scope_df.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Migration scope", index=False)
        issues_df.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Issues", index=False)
        profile_df.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Column profile", index=False)
        enum_df.to_excel(w, sheet_name="Enum values", index=False)
    if not LOCAL_PATH:
        dest = f"{OUTPUT_URI}/{RUN_TS}"
        mssparkutils.fs.cp(f"file:{report}", f"{dest}/s62a_extraction_validation.xlsx")
        for name, frame in {"summary": summary_df, "issues": issues_df, "column_profile": profile_df,
                            "migration_scope": scope_df, "enum_values": enum_df}.items():
            mssparkutils.fs.put(f"{dest}/{name}.csv", frame.to_csv(index=False), True)
        print(f"Written to {dest}")
    else:
        print(f"Written to {report}")

# Optional: fail the pipeline on ERRORs
